name: peopleworks-xaf
description: Give an AI coding agent knowledge of a specific DevExpress XAF application: its entities, controllers, actions, business rules and Model Editor customizations, extracted from source with Roslyn. Complements the official DevExpress agent skills, which teach how XAF works in general.

plugins.description: MCP server and skill for querying your own XAF application: complete inventories of entities, controllers and actions, business rules, criteria expressions, and .xafml customizations that exist in no C# file.
